blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Travelers will get another reprieve next month as the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) announced lower fuel surcharges for the first half of December. The aviation regulator said in an advisory that it would impose a Level 13 fuel surcharge from Dec. 1 to 15, three levels lower than the Level 16 it set for the second half of November.
